title: Unraveling the Molecular Mechanisms of Estragole in Colorectal Cancer Cells: A Proteomics-Based Investigation.
snippet: Estragole (EST), a naturally occurring phenylpropanoid found in several aromatic plants and essential oils, has demonstrated a range of biological effects, including cytotoxic activity in experimental cancer models.
